class.name: GameplayCooldownTracker
class.brief_description: Deterministic cooldown tracker for ability and shared activation locks.
class.description: Tracks exact ability tags and optional shared group cooldowns in an explicit, caller-controlled time domain. Inspired by Unreal Engine Gameplay Ability cooldown tags. [method try_start] checks individual and shared cooldowns and commits both atomically. [method tick] advances the clock; [method replace_snapshot] updates from authoritative replicated state transactionally. Does not perform gameplay, automatically synchronize over a network, or read wall-clock time. A server must remain authoritative. Stores up to 256 cooldowns, each with a duration at most seven days.

method.name: set_remaining
method.description: Sets the exact remaining time. Zero clears the tag. Rejects negative or non-finite seconds without changing state.

method.name: try_start
method.description: Atomically starts a new cooldown if its tag and optional shared group tag are ready. Positive group_seconds creates a shared cooldown; zero only checks for an existing group lock. A missing group tag cannot have a nonzero group duration.

method.name: reduce_remaining
method.description: Shortens an existing cooldown. Returns false if the cooldown is absent or the requested reduction invalid.

method.name: remove_cooldown
method.description: Removes one exact cooldown and returns whether it was present.

method.name: replace_snapshot
method.description: Transactionally replaces all cooldowns with a mapping of exact tags to nonnegative remaining seconds. Invalid input leaves the previous cooldowns untouched; zero durations are omitted.

method.name: replace_cooldown_branch
method.description: Atomically replaces exact cooldown tags at or under a dotted [param branch], retaining all unrelated timers and their remaining durations. For example, [code]Ability[/code] updates [code]Ability.Weapon[/code] and [code]Ability.Global[/code] without changing [code]Local.UI.Activation.Weapon[/code] or [code]AbilityExtra.Weapon[/code]. Every incoming tag must belong to this branch; all keys and durations are validated before committing. Rejects aliases, nonnumeric/nonfinite/negative durations, invalid branch names, and total capacity overflow without changing the tracker. Durations of zero remove branch tags. The operation does not advance time, trigger abilities or grant network authority.

method.name: get_snapshot
method.description: Returns a new mapping of exact cooldown tags to remaining seconds.

method.name: tick
method.description: Advances by positive finite delta and returns expired tags in insertion order. Invalid deltas do nothing.

method.name: get_remaining
method.description: Returns remaining seconds for this exact tag, or zero if absent.

method.name: get_effective_remaining
method.description: Returns the greater of the ability's cooldown and its optional shared group's cooldown.

method.name: is_ready
method.description: Returns whether neither this ability nor its shared group is currently cooling down.

method.name: get_cooldown_count
method.description: Returns number of live cooldown tags.
